module_summary: Three-state Mealy FSM detecting overlapping 101 on serial x, async active-low reset; z asserted in S10 when x is 1.

anchors.name: state
anchors.why: 2-bit state register tracking 101 prefix (S, S1, S10); controls next state and z.

anchors.name: z
anchors.why: Mealy detect output: x while in state S10.

groups.name: sequence_detector
groups.description: Next-state logic on x, state register and Mealy output decode.
